name: Sam's Club Café Vanilla Frozen Yogurt Cup & Brownie Sundae (Skip 4-Berry Seeds)
brandOrRestaurant: Sam's Club Café (Logan, South Jordan & Nationwide)
whyItWorks: Sam's Club's $1.00 cultured Vanilla Frozen Yogurt cup is lower in fat and lactose than standard hard ice cream and completely seedless.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the plain Vanilla Frozen Yogurt Cup or the Brownie Sundae (with a Lactaid), and strictly skip the 4-Berry Sundae topping (loaded with blackberry/raspberry seeds).
watchOuts: Avoid the 4-Berry Topping Sundae due to whole berry seeds
